probe.title: Your Page Title
probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Halden® Pricing Changelog Help Blog About Overview Buy Halden App Store Google Play © 2026 Halden® Getting started Pick your first thing Choose tomorrow's one thing tonight and set the reminder that brings you back. Halden asks you for one thing a day. Not a list, not a plan: one task that would make tomorrow count if it were the only thing you finished. The best time to choose it is the evening before, when today is still fresh and tomorrow has not started pulling at you. Choose it tonight Open Halden and tap Tomorrow at the bottom of the screen. Write the thing in a few words, the way you would on a sticky note. Tap Set and close the app. That is the whole evening routine. In the morning, Today opens with your thing at the top and nothing else on the screen. What makes a good one thing A good one thing is specific enough that you know when it is done. “Work on the report” is hard to finish; “Send the first draft of the report to Marta” is not. Start with a verb: send, write, call, fix, book. Keep it to something you can finish in a morning. If it feels too big, pick the first part and leave the rest for another day.
